title: Personal Credit Cards: Annual Fee Amounts and First-Year Waiver
content:
Only two tiers of Personal Credit Cards carry an annual fee. The fee is charged annually, on the statement whose closing date falls in the calendar month of the account's opening; one tier forgoes it during the first account year.

| Tier | Annual fee | Fee forgone in the first account year |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| College Rewards Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 95.00 USD | yes |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 395.00 USD | no |

## Points of judgement

- Where the table shows 0.00 USD, no annual fee entry ever appears on the card.
- The first-year waiver belongs to Travel Rewards Visa Signature alone; Visa Infinite Private Client bills its fee from the first anniversary-month statement onward.

> Hypothetical illustration: of two cardholders, one with Cash Rewards Visa and one with Visa Infinite Private Client, only the second ever sees an annual fee entry, and its amount is 395.00 USD.
